title: Lithum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Lithum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lithum is a void-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Vitality (B), Agility (A).

sections.title: Is the Lithum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Agility (A). A dedicated void pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
